features.photoAlt: A team member checks a fridge temperature on a phone

inspections.title: The proof is already written down.
inspections.body: Every check is stored with who did it, when, and whether it was on time. Filter by date, category or result, then print a clean report.

points.timing: On time, late and missed checks shown side by side
points.print: One-click printable report for any date range
points.history: Records stay intact even when equipment or forms change

install.question: Do I need to install anything?
install.answer: No. SafeCheck runs in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer. You can also add it to the home screen so it opens like an app.

ownChecks.question: Can I set up the checks from my own HACCP plan?
ownChecks.answer: Yes. You create the forms yourself (ticks, temperatures, choices, notes and dates, each with its own limits) and schedule them as recurring tasks for every fridge, area or site.

outOfRange.question: What happens when a reading is out of range?
outOfRange.answer: It's flagged as soon as it's entered, and the form can ask for a corrective action before the record is saved. The deviation and what was done about it are recorded together.

sites.question: Can I manage more than one site?
sites.answer: Yes. Add every site you have, each with its own equipment, areas and schedule. Staff only see the sites they're assigned to.

inspection.question: What do I show an inspector?
inspection.answer: Open the records for any day or period: every check with its time, its result and whether it was done on time, late or missed. You can print them too.

cta.title: Put the clipboard down.
cta.body: Set SafeCheck up with your own fridges, forms and schedule. It takes less time than this morning's temperature round.
